series_label: Maternal mortality ratio (number of maternal deaths per 100,000 live births)
source_or_custodian: UNICEF SDMX data warehouse, dataflow UNICEF/MNCH/1.0 (Maternal, child and newborn health); DATA_SOURCE code MNCH_SRC_2919 (code only, no label returned)
status_or_notes: Data returned for 2000-2023 only; no values for 2024 or 2025. OBS_STATUS=MD and OBS_CONF=F in the sampled rows (2000, 2001).
